name: rosetta-list-comprehensions-02-using-a-generator
code:
use default

triples(n: int) -> Pipe[(int, int, int)] is
    for a in 1::n do
        for b in a::n do
            for c in b::n do
                if a * a + b * b == c * c then
                    yield (a, b, c)
                fi
            od
        od
    od
si

write_line(triples(20) |> join(", "))

use default

triples(n: int) -> Pipe[(int, int, int)] is
    for a in 1::n do
        for b in a::n do
            for c in b::n do
                if a * a + b * b == c * c then
                    yield (a, b, c)
                fi
            od
        od
    od
si

write_line(triples(20) |> join(", "))
